QuestionStmt.S: Which from following compounds has highest boiling point?

Solution.S:
Boiling point increases with molecular weight due to stronger van der Waals forces.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Compound} & \text{Formula} & \text{Boiling point} \\
\hline
\text{Acetaldehyde} & \mathrm{CH_3CHO} & 21^\circ\text{C} \\
\text{Propionaldehyde} & \mathrm{CH_3CH_2CHO} & 48^\circ\text{C} \\
\text{Butyraldehyde} & \mathrm{CH_3(CH_2)_2CHO} & 75^\circ\text{C} \\
\text{Valeraldehyde} & \mathrm{CH_3(CH_2)_3CHO} & 103^\circ\text{C} \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

Valeraldehyde has the highest boiling point. Hence the correct option is D.
